cardOverview.overviewText: A premium charge card offering 4x Membership Rewards points on dining, travel, and retail purchases. Cardholders enjoy access to global Amex Offers, exclusive event invitations, and concierge services.

items.child: 20% Discount on Dining Bills at Select Partner Restaurants

benefitRows.name: Dining
benefitRows.description: 20% Discount on Dining Bills at Select Partner Restaurants
benefitRows.offer: Enjoy a 20% discount on dining bills at select partner restaurants; get up to 25% off on order-ins from The Leela, The Oberoi Gurgaon, The Lodhi, Hilton, Accor, Roseate, and Qmin; and receive up to 50% discount for up to 10 guests at The Lodhi.
benefitRows.howToAvail: To avail this benefit, log in to the dining partner’s app or website using your registered account. Explore available dining and order-in offers, select your preferred meals or restaurants, and apply the benefit at checkout to enjoy exclusive dining privileges. Complete the payment using your American Express Gold Charge card to unlock the offer.

benefitRows.name: Insurance
benefitRows.offer: If the loss is reported to the bank within three working days, the liability of the cardholder would be zero.|Otherwise, if the issue is noted after three days, the detriment of the cardholder would be limited to ₹1,000.
benefitRows.howToAvail: To avail this insurance, report the incident to American Express at 1800 102 2355 and for email support contact amexsupport@icicilombard.com.
